paths.description: Homepage listing and entry experience; represents primary discovery, age gate, search, cards, pagination, and global chrome.
Representative video detail/playback page; covers the core watch journey, media, article metadata, and detail-template network cost.
Actor taxonomy/listing page; represents a distinct index template and guided browsing route.
Abuse/DMCA report page; represents the primary safety/reporting journey and content page template.
Nonexistent route used to inspect HTTP/network failure handling and recovery.

findings.summary: Deceptive fake verification and stacked overlays obstruct core content
findings.evidence: The legitimate age gate is stacked with a fake CAPTCHA-style “Robot Verification” ad and transparent top-layer click capture on multiple templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deceptive overlays and click-capture layers. Keep one clearly branded, accessible age gate using a native dialog with explicit choices and no ads inside or above it.

findings.summary: Core accessibility failures affect names, contrast, focus, and zoom
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.79 and failed colour contrast, form labels, link names, iframe titles, and zoom. The focused first link had a 0 px outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every field/control/frame an accessible name, restore visible :focus-visible styling, meet WCAG contrast, and remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions.

findings.summary: Slow LCP and excessive delivery delay the primary view
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 9.2 s LCP, 12.7 s TTI, and 318 KiB unused JS. HAR recorded 105 requests and 1.55 MB with parser-blocking assets and weak caching.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset, remove/defer nonessential ad and legacy scripts, trim unused bundles, add durable caching, and shorten blocking chains.

findings.summary: Third-party advertising and analytics dominate data and bytes
findings.evidence: The trackers probe found 24 third-party origins; 45 home requests transferred 1.33 MB from third parties, around 86% of the load.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit and remove low-value ad/tracker vendors, load optional vendors only after informed consent, batch/minimise analytics, and set a strict third-party budget.

findings.summary: Dozens of failed resources and console errors degrade reliability
findings.evidence: Home HAR recorded 39 HTTP 503 responses and detail recorded 21; Lighthouse also failed console errors, inspector issues, and BFCache.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the failing image/CDN paths, provide resilient image/error fallbacks and retry UI, and eliminate console/inspector/BFCache blockers.

findings.summary: The document language and direction contradict the Persian content
findings.evidence: The audited templates declare lang="en-US" and no dir while the visible content is predominantly Persian RTL.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct Persian language tag and dir="rtl" at the document root; use logical properties and mark isolated English fragments as needed.

findings.summary: Zoom is disabled and the representative video has no captions
findings.evidence: Viewport metadata sets maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=0 and the detail video has no track elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user zoom and provide synchronised captions or an equivalent transcript for media.

findings.summary: Missing CSP and insecure analytics cookie settings weaken defenses
findings.evidence: Headers show no Content-Security-Policy; both _ga cookies are non-Secure, SameSite=None, and 400 days long.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive nonce/hash-based CSP and mark analytics cookies Secure with an appropriate SameSite/lifetime policy.

findings.summary: Images are not responsive, modern, or efficiently deferred
findings.evidence: Images probe found 41/41 without srcset, 41 legacy formats, 37 below-fold without native lazy loading, one unsized, and three oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants with srcset/sizes, add intrinsic dimensions, and lazy-load below-fold images while prioritising only the LCP image.

findings.summary: Account forms lack autofill and humane validation semantics
findings.evidence: Inspected sign-up/login fields omit autocomplete; several labels are not associated and required/error state is class-based rather than semantic.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct autocomplete tokens, explicit labels/required attributes, and interaction-timed accessible error announcements.

findings.summary: Theme, reduced-motion, and contrast preferences are not fully honoured
findings.evidence: Dark/high-contrast captures and CSS/animation probes found a fixed theme, no reduced-motion rule, and a running 790 ms animation; Lighthouse contrast failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme, add preference-driven theme tokens, suppress nonessential motion under reduce, and provide forced-colors/prefers-contrast-safe control styling.

findings.evidence: DOM inspection found public sign-up/login/reset forms but no WebAuthn or passkey capability.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys for registration and authentication, retaining a secure recovery path.

findings.summary: Custom overlays bypass semantic dialog/popover behaviour
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no dialog or popover elements; age and account overlays are custom div/modal structures.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for the modal age/account flows and popover for transient UI, with native focus management and light dismiss where appropriate.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport rules rather than container responsiveness
findings.evidence: Mobile layouts avoid overflow, but CSS inspection found no @container adaptation for reused cards and overlays.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and component-scoped @container rules where cards/overlays are reused at different widths.

findings.summary: Route, scroll, and gesture behaviour uses legacy scripting instead of modern declarative primitives
findings.evidence: No View Transition or scroll timeline CSS was found; jquery.touchSwipe is shipped.
findings.suggestedFix: Use View Transitions for meaningful route/state changes and declarative scroll/gesture primitives where motion adds orientation, respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Long pages provide little state-aware navigation guidance
findings.evidence: No scroll-state chrome, anchor positioning, directional transitions, or progress cue was found on long listing pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight current-location/scroll cues and use anchor positioning for overlays/tooltips where applicable.

findings.summary: Metadata and heading quality is inconsistent across templates
findings.evidence: Homepage has no H1 and report page has no meta description, although canonical/indexing and detail structured data are sound.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive H1 to the homepage and unique descriptions to content templates such as Report.
